name: Satoru Gojo
notes: Infinity uses spatial manipulation to infinitely slow matter/energy based on mass, speed, and cursed energy. Hollow Purple is a virtual mass that conventionally obliterates matter (but is NOT true absolute erasure, as it can be tanked by extreme durability). Weak to domain amplification, spatial-cutting, or absolute bypass.

name: Ryomen Sukuna
notes: Cleave automatically adjusts its power to match the target's toughness and cursed energy. Malevolent Shrine is an open-barrier domain with guaranteed slashes. World-Cutting Slash targets the literal coordinates of space, entirely ignoring physical durability. Vulnerable to direct soul-strikes.

name: Yuji Itadori
notes: Possesses superhuman physicals supplemented by Shrine (Cleave/Dismantle), Blood Manipulation, and chaining Black Flashes. Can strike the boundary of souls directly, dealing durability-ignoring damage to reincarnated/fused entities. No innate ranged hax defense.

name: Megumi Fushiguro
notes: Summons Mahoraga, who adapts to any phenomena (physical or conceptual) after being exposed to it once via a turning wheel. Can be killed instantly if destroyed by a single, overwhelmingly powerful attack before the adaptation process completes.

name: Mahito
notes: Idle Transfiguration reshapes the soul upon physical contact, causing the body to mutate or instantly die, entirely bypassing physical durability. Only countered by subconscious soul-protection (like innate cursed energy defenses) or being completely blitzed.

name: Geto Suguru
notes: Cursed Spirit Manipulation allows him to deploy thousands of curses. Maximum: Uzumaki condenses them into raw energy and extracts their innate techniques. Lacks personal defensive hax; vulnerable to fast melee rushdowns or AoE that wipes his curses.

name: Toji Fushiguro
notes: Heavenly Restriction grants zero cursed energy (making him invisible to domains/sensing) and superhuman stats. The Split Soul Katana ignores physical toughness to cut the soul directly, and the Inverted Spear of Heaven forcefully nullifies all cursed techniques/magic.

name: Nanami Kento
notes: Ratio Technique forcibly creates a weak point at the 7:3 ratio of any target or object, allowing him to deal critical damage regardless of base toughness. A pure physical striker with no defensive hax.

name: Muzan
notes: Possesses 5 brains and 7 hearts with near-instantaneous regeneration. His blood attacks on a cellular level, destroying living tissue. Strictly limited to melee/whip range and is fundamentally weak to cellular-halting sunlight or equivalent soul/erasure hax.

name: Naruto Uzumaki
notes: Baryon Mode fuses chakra like nuclear fusion, elevating speed to Otsutsuki-blitzing tiers. Sustained physical contact directly shaves away the opponent's lifespan/life-force. It grants zero regeneration, burns Naruto/Kurama's own lifespan, and only lasts minutes.

name: Sasuke Uchiha
notes: Possesses the Perfect Susano'o (a mountain-sized chakra avatar). His Mangekyo casts Amaterasu (inextinguishable black flames), while his Rinnegan allows Amenotejikara (instantaneous spatial swapping of himself, others, or attacks within a set range).

name: Kaguya Otsutsuki
notes: Can instantly shift environments/dimensions via Amenominaka. The Expansive Truth-Seeker Orb can erase a dimension, and All-Killing Ash Bones disintegrate targets on contact (durability negation). Loses only to instantaneous sealing or dimensional BFR.

name: Kakashi Hatake
notes: Dual Mangekyo Sharingan grants temporary perfect Kamui: passive intangibility (phasing through all matter/energy) and the ability to warp targets away via Kamui Shuriken/Lightning Blade (spatial durability negation). Limited by a strict chakra time limit.

name: Madara Uchiha
notes: Juubi Jinchuriki wielding Truth-Seeker Orbs (which disintegrate matter on contact), Limbo clones (invisible, intangible shadows existing in a parallel dimension), and immense regeneration. Susceptible to senjutsu, space-time hax, or soul erasure.

name: Might Guy
notes: The Eighth Gate of Death removes all bodily limiters. His ultimate attack, Night Guy, warps the physical space around the target due to sheer mass and velocity, preventing standard evasion. It is a one-time, completely fatal burst.

name: Obito Uchiha
notes: As the Juubi Jinchuriki, he possesses Truth-Seeker Orbs and extreme regeneration, but he CANNOT use Kamui intangibility (the Juubi's mass prevents him from phasing). Still highly resistant to all ninjutsu except natural energy (senjutsu).

name: Itachi Uchiha
notes: Edo Tensei grants infinite chakra and regeneration. Susano'o wields the Totsuka Blade (seals anything it pierces into a genjutsu realm forever) and the Yata Mirror (alters its attributes to negate any elemental/physical attack). Tsukuyomi alters perception of time.

name: Hashirama Senju
notes: Wood Release allows the creation of a massive 1000-armed Buddha construct that dwarfs mountains. Sage mode grants immense stamina and passive, seal-less cellular regeneration. Vulnerable to hax that directly ignores physical HP/barriers.

name: Minato Namikaze
notes: Flying Raijin allows instantaneous, FTL teleportation to any pre-marked seal, making him virtually impossible to hit conventionally. Wields half of Kurama (Edo form) for massive chakra/AP. Loses only if the opponent's AoE is larger than his tag network.

name: Izuku Midoriya
notes: One For All 100% combined with Gearshift (allows him to alter the velocity/inertia of himself or his target, ignoring the laws of physics) and Fa Jin (stored kinetic energy for burst speed). Fragile against durability negation or psychic/soul attacks.

name: Katsuki Bakugo
notes: Sweat-ignited explosions culminating in the Cluster technique, where explosions detonate simultaneously across his body for extreme burst speed and AP. High mobility but standard human durability; loses to foes who can tank his highest output.

name: Shoto Todoroki
notes: Phosphor technique harmonizes his two halves to create cold fire, allowing massive AoE temperature control without exhausting his body. No innate hax defense; vulnerable to speedblitzes before he can activate his fields.

name: All For One
notes: Possesses dozens of stacked Quirks (impact recoil, air cannons, hyper-regeneration). In his Rewind state, he reverts to his physical prime and recovers from any damage, but will eventually rewind into non-existence. Can steal powers upon physical contact.

name: Tomura Shigaraki
notes: Decay disintegrates whatever he touches, and the effect aggressively spreads through the air/ground to destroy entire cities instantly (absolute durability negation). Possesses AFO's quirks and hyper-regeneration. Vulnerable to flight/range or true intangibility.

name: Star and Stripe
notes: New Order allows her to dictate two rules on anything she names and touches. She can remove the atmosphere or command a target's heart to stop. However, she cannot exceed absolute physical limits or affect a target if she doesn't know their true identity.

name: All Might
notes: Prime All Might possesses purely physical superhuman strength and speed, generating localized weather-changing wind pressure via punches. He has no hax abilities or magical defenses, making him vulnerable to durability negation or dimensional manipulation.

name: Goku
notes: Mastered Ultra Instinct allows his body to fight and evade autonomously without thought. Can project a massive, Susano'o-like ki avatar for overwhelming physical AP. Vulnerable to absolute reality warping or hax that ignores physical evasion.

name: Vegeta
notes: Ultra Ego forces him to draw power from his fighting spirit, making him physically stronger the more damage he sustains. Wields Hakai, an energy that erases matter and souls from existence. Can be defeated if one-shot before his power scales.

name: Gohan
notes: Beast Form grants extreme, instantaneous burst AP and speed, allowing him to overpower top-tier divine threats. A purely straightforward brawler with immense ki output but minimal hax defense against conceptual or soul-based attacks.

name: Piccolo
notes: Orange Piccolo grants giant-form strength and Namekian cellular regeneration (can survive as long as his core anatomy remains). Special Beam Cannon drills through targets, piercing higher durability. Vulnerable to full vaporization or soul erasure.

name: Krillin
notes: The Destructo Disc focuses ki into a razor-thin edge that can cut through opponents with vastly superior durability. Employs the Solar Flare to blind opponents. Retains standard human durability; loses instantly in close-quarters combat.

name: Future Trunks
notes: Super Saiyan Rage grants godly stat scaling. The Sword of Hope gathers ambient energy from all living things into a massive, durability-negating blade capable of destroying immortal/fused entities. Vulnerable to speedblitzes before the energy gathers.

name: Frieza
notes: Black Frieza possesses enough raw AP to instantly one-shot Mastered Ultra Instinct and Ultra Ego simultaneously. Can survive in the vacuum of space and endure being physically bisected. Vulnerable only to conceptual hax, sealing, or absolute erasure.

name: Cell
notes: Perfect Cell can regenerate completely as long as a single core cell in his head survives. Possesses the genetic data and techniques of Goku, Vegeta, Piccolo, and Frieza. Can self-destruct with enough power to wipe out a solar system.

name: Asta
notes: Wields Anti-Magic swords that passively nullify, sever, and reflect any supernatural energy, magic, or hax upon contact (acting as durability negation against magical defenses). Devil Union grants FTL speed but he is vulnerable to purely physical, non-magical blunt force.

name: Yuno
notes: Spirit Dive with Sylph grants FTL flight and evasive wind mobility. Spirit of Zephyr condenses atmospheric magic to erode target defenses, while Star Magic allows instantaneous teleportation between designated points. A glass cannon vulnerable to anti-magic.

name: Noelle Silva
notes: Saint Valkyrie armor purifies malice and grants 3D mobility through the air. Sea Dragon's Roar delivers massive blunt-force water damage. Vulnerable to extreme heat/evaporation, durability negation, or superior physical speed.

name: Yami Sukehiro
notes: Dark Magic is slow but can interact with abstract concepts. Dimension Slash and Death Thrust literally sever the fabric of space itself, completely ignoring the physical durability of the target. Ki sensing prevents blind-spot attacks. Vulnerable to overwhelming range.

name: Julius Novachrono
notes: Time Magic allows him to steal time from targets to age them instantly, trap them in stasis spheres, or use stored time to heal fatal wounds (rewind). Requires casting time and relies heavily on his stored reserves; vulnerable to instantaneous blitzes.

name: Lucifero
notes: Manifests the concept of Gravity. His presence passively crushes everything in the vicinity flat to the ground, disrupting magic and physical movement alike. Can warp space to teleport. Vulnerable to dimensional severing or foes completely immune to gravity.

name: Gon Freecss
notes: Utilizes Jajanken (Rock, Paper, Scissors) to focus aura into massive physical strikes or mid-range projectiles. A purely physical combatant reliant on Nen basics with no hax defenses, making him highly susceptible to ranged or conceptual abilities.

name: Adult Gon
notes: Forced a Vow to consume all of his future Nen potential, granting him temporary strength and speed capable of decimating Royal Guard Neferpitou. It is a one-time burst that leaves his body entirely destroyed and comatose afterward.

name: Killua Zoldyck
notes: Godspeed (Kanmuru) bypasses his nervous system, programming his aura to react automatically to malice or movement with lightning speed. Highly evasive with lethal physical assassination techniques, but his electrical aura drains rapidly.

name: Kurapika
notes: Emperor Time grants 100% Nen efficiency against ANY opponent at the cost of his lifespan. Judgment Chain wraps around the heart to enforce a lethal rule. (Chain Jail, the unbreakable bind, is strictly limited to the Phantom Troupe). Vulnerable to stamina drain.

name: Hisoka Morow
notes: Bungee Gum possesses the properties of both rubber and gum, used to tether opponents, return projectiles, or physically bind limbs. Texture Surprise alters appearances. Relies entirely on battle IQ and physical traps; lacks high-tier AP or hax.

name: Feitan Portor
notes: Pain Packer transmutes the physical damage he has received into a miniature, scorching sun (Rising Sun) that incinerates a wide area. He must survive the initial damage to cast it, making him vulnerable to instantaneous one-shots or decapitation.

name: Chrollo Lucilfer
notes: Skill Hunter allows him to steal and combine other Nen abilities (teleportation, explosive puppets) from a conjured book. He must fulfill strict conditions to steal a power and needs preparation time to assemble lethal combinations. Vulnerable to immediate rushdowns.

name: Meruem
notes: Post-Rose form possesses unparalleled physical strength and speed, flight, and Photon (turns his aura into microscopic light particles that read the intent and location of anyone they touch). Extremely durable but died to cellular-level radiation/poison.

name: Isaac Netero
notes: The 100-Type Guanyin Bodhisattva delivers physical strikes at sub-millisecond speeds (faster than sound/thought). Zero Hand expends all his aura in a single beam. If his heart stops, the Poor Man's Rose (a miniature nuclear/poison bomb) detonates instantly.

name: Meliodas
notes: Full Counter reflects any magical/energy attack back at the user with more than double the power. True Magic form destroys curses. Vulnerable to purely physical strikes, environmental hazards, or non-attack conceptual hax that cannot be 'reflected'.

name: Escanor
notes: His power, Sunshine, peaks precisely at noon (The One), granting him physical stats that overpower gods, alongside heat that melts stone passively. He is strictly bound by the time of day; his power plummets as the sun sets, making him useless at night.

name: Merlin
notes: Infinity allows her to freeze the time of her spells, making barriers, flames, or ice last forever without consuming extra mana. Absolute Cancel disrupts enemy magic. Physically human; vulnerable to being speedblitzed before she can cast a spell.

name: Ban
notes: Snatch forcibly rips physical strength or internal organs from a target at range. Post-Purgatory Ban sacrificed his immortality to revive Elaine; he no longer regenerates. However, his mortal body possesses extreme durability and pain tolerance from millennia in Purgatory.

name: King
notes: Wields the True Spirit Spear Chastiefol, utilizing multiple forms simultaneously (massive guardian constructs, thousands of homing blades, petrifying pollen, and sunflower beams) from a distance. Physically frail without the spear's protection.

name: Diane
notes: Giant clan warrior with immense physical strength and Creation magic, allowing her to manipulate the earth, create massive golems, and turn her body into heavy metal for defense. Lacks speed and defensive hax against conceptual attacks.

name: Gowther
notes: A magical doll entirely immune to physical pain or conventional death. His magic, Invasion, operates on the mind—rewriting memories, casting illusions, or forcing nervous systems to shut down. Vulnerable to opponents with total mind-control immunity.

name: Estarossa
notes: Wields the Love commandment, completely paralyzing anyone who feels hatred or killing intent toward him. Uses Full Counter to reflect physical attacks at double power (the inverse of Meliodas). Vulnerable to emotionless beings or magical barrages.

name: Zeldris
notes: The Piety commandment forces anyone who turns their back on him into absolute submission. Ominous Nebula creates a gravitational vortex of darkness that pulls targets in and slashes them at imperceptible speeds. Vulnerable to extreme AP that breaks the vortex.

name: Chaos
notes: The primordial creator entity. Possesses the ability to warp reality on a planetary scale, manipulate life and death, and alter the fabric of space. It requires an equally abstract, cosmic-level entity or absolute conceptual erasure to defeat.

name: Supreme Deity
notes: The creator of the Goddess Clan. Possesses complete immunity to dark magic and physical curses, capable of dropping massive barrages of divine light and manipulating weather/energy. Cannot be defeated by standard demon magic.

name: Thragg
notes: A Viltrumite warlord with millennia of combat experience. Possesses massively FTL travel speed, the strength to rip through planetary cores, and extreme durability. Entirely physical combatant with zero defensive hax against soul, magical, or reality-warping attacks.

name: Battle Beast
notes: A physical powerhouse whose strength, savagery, and durability allowed him to fight Thragg for days straight in the vacuum of space, even with his own organs ruptured. Strictly a melee brawler; vulnerable to dimensional removal or hax he cannot punch.

name: Omni-Man
notes: Viltrumite genetics grant continent-cracking strength, FTL flight, and the ability to hold his breath in space for weeks. Fights purely with physical blunt force and speed. Susceptible to telepathy, magic, molecular manipulation, or durability-negating hax.

name: Allen the Alien
notes: An Unopan whose genetics force his body to adapt and grow exponentially stronger every time he survives a near-death experience, eventually rivaling top Viltrumites. Has limited telepathy but relies primarily on physical brawling.

name: Invincible
notes: End-of-series Mark Grayson is the strongest Viltrumite, surpassing Omni-Man and Thragg in raw strength and speed. He possesses no ranged attacks or supernatural hax, making him vulnerable to reality-warpers, magic, or soul manipulation.

name: Atom Eve
notes: Possesses the ability to completely rewrite the molecular structure of inorganic matter (turning air to shields, metal to glass). Mental blocks prevent her from altering living biology, unless her life is in immediate danger, at which point she can resurrect herself.

name: Thor
notes: Rune King Thor is merged with the Odinforce and the magic of the Runes. He is virtually omniscient, can manipulate reality on a universal scale, freeze time, and erase cosmic entities from existence. Cannot be defeated by purely physical force.

name: Hulk
notes: The Devil Hulk/Immortal Hulk persona grants strength that scales infinitely with rage and an extreme healing factor. He cannot permanently die, as his soul returns through the 'Green Door'. Vulnerable to reality manipulation or extreme magical sealing.

name: Homelander
notes: The comic version possesses standard flying-brick powers (flight, heat vision, super strength) but is physically weaker than the television adaptation. He can be killed by extreme blunt force (equivalent to heavy military ordnance) and possesses absolutely zero hax.
